test_title: PYST 27: Selection Post (Matric Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 2 Feb 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements. 

**Statements:**

All boxes are gifts. 

All gifts are cards. 

**Conclusions :**

I. Some boxes are cards.

II. All cards are boxes.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is given according to the given information.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1de8187f67a32e7a839dca8c2bf85f8f0ec41d8aa99a31d2b4e05242a95e11d1.png] 

Conclusions :

I. Some boxes are cards → Follow → (As all boxes are gifts and all gifts are cards. So, some boxes are card is definite follow)

II. All cards are boxes → Does not follow → (As all boxes are gifts and all gifts are cards. So, all cards are boxes is not followed)

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only conclusion I follows".**
